verdict.rationale: The settings docs describe a Telemetry toggle to enable or disable sharing interaction logs to improve models. That is a direct user-level opt-out of training use, but it is a single brief mention. It does not say whether code and prompts are covered by 'interaction logs', and there is no evidence of a lead enforcing it team-wide. Missing for 10: explicit statement that code and prompts are excluded from training when disabled, a data-usage or training policy document, admin/org-level enforcement of the opt-out, independent corroboration.
